source.summary: Fix off-by-one in Bits length check

description: Bits(val, len_) silently accepted 2**len_ (which needs len_+1 bits) because the guard used `val > 2 ** len_` instead of `val >= 2 ** len_`. Bits(4, 2) produced a 3-bit value with a declared len of 2. seed/mod.py is the verbatim pre-fix Bits class extracted to a standalone module; seed/test_mod.py is the real PR's regression test; seed/mod_fixed.py is the real fix (oracle reference).
repo_open_issues_note: boltons has many open bug issues; this is one of a stream of recently-merged bug-fix PRs.
